# Agent

An agent as data: one `loom.agent/1` document naming the agent and its brief, its models, the harness session it may run (kind, run budget, stop policy, confinement and tool policy), its outer and inner loop, the states an item is projected by, the bindings it reads and writes through, its channel, write policy, capabilities, exposure, runtime and deployment.

`loom.agent` is one of loom's bounded contexts. [All domains](./index.mdx).

## Errors

### `A2aRefused`

It carries:

- `reason` — `loom.agent.A2aRefusalReason`

Reported by `loom.agent.AdmitA2aRequest` on its `missing-bearer` and `wrong-bearer` outcomes.

### `HttpReadRefused`

It carries:

- `reason` — `loom.agent.HttpReadRefusalReason`

Reported by `loom.agent.AdmitHttpRead` on its `method-not-get`, `path-not-allowed` and `bearer-missing` outcomes.

Reported by `loom.agent.BoundHttpAnswer` on its `redirected` and `failed-status` outcomes.

### `HttpTrustRefused`

It carries:

- `reason` — `loom.agent.HttpTrustRefusalReason`

Reported by `loom.agent.AdmitHttpTrust` on its `unreadable`, `too-large` and `no-certificate` outcomes.

### `SendRefused`

It carries:

- `reason` — `loom.agent.SendRefusalReason`
- `final` — `Boolean`

Reported by `loom.agent.AdmitSend` on its `writes-none`, `outside-allow-list`, `no-proposal` and `rate-limited` outcomes.

### `ServeRefused`

It carries:

- `reason` — `loom.agent.ServeRefusalReason`

Reported by `loom.agent.AdmitServe` on its `nothing-to-serve` outcome.

### `SpecRefused`

It carries:

- `reason` — `loom.agent.RefusalReason`
- `member` — `String`
- `detail` — `String`

Reported by `loom.agent.CheckAgentSpec` on its `malformed`, `secret-literal`, `unknown-format`, `blank-text`, `not-a-variable-name`, `port-out-of-range`, `not-a-plain-path`, `not-an-instant`, `unknown-protocol`, `unknown-action`, `unbound-source`, `http-method`, `send-without-writes` and `empty-channel-allow` outcomes.
